title: OutcomOwner
description:
Summary
 Within the Software Engineering Department of the IAMS Business Unit, the successful candidate will join a team of approximately 15 members developing key components of an innovative cloud-based authentication platform.
The organization is structured around customer-centric squads combining human expertise and AI-enabled capabilities. The candidate will act as the Outcome Owner for one of these squads, driving the delivery of measurable customer value for a specific Job To Be Done (JTBD).
The Outcome Owner is one of three archetypes in every squad, alongside the Solution Architect/Builder and the Experience Crafter. Where the Builder owns how and the Crafter owns how it feels , the Outcome Owner owns what and why : the job, the evidence behind it, and the business outcome it must deliver. He/she is accountable for making sure the JTBD squad solves the right customer problem and can prove it did.
 Essential Duties
 Own the job . Define and maintain the squad's JTBD cluster: who the customer is, what job they hire IAMS to do, and what "done well" looks like to them. 
 Generate the evidence . Run continuous discovery — customer interviews, usage data, support signals, win/los
